name: Nuxa
oneLiner: AI operating system for restaurants that runs a set of AI agents for reviews, local visibility, social, phone answering and revenue monitoring.
bestFor: Independent restaurants and small groups that want review replies handled inside a broader AI marketing and operations system.
features: Grace, a review agent that replies to Google reviews in the restaurant's voice
Positive reviews can be auto-replied; complaints and low ratings are drafted for owner approval
Review themes surfaced as operational feedback
Scout, an agent that audits listings and visibility against local competitors, including AI search
Dash, an agent that connects to POS data and flags revenue and item-mix changes
Social agent that posts and measures campaigns
AI phone answering and ordering chatbot with POS sync
Integrations with Toast, Square, Clover and Fleksa

pricing.text: No published pricing for the full platform; contact Nuxa. Its AI phone answering product lists Pro plans from $49/month.

notes: Thin evidence: all details come from search snippets of nuxa.ai's own pages (nuxa.ai cannot be reached from this session).
